title: Ep 16 — Anthropic gives agents working hands, and the essay tool that limped to two thousand dollars before it hit ten million a year
description: Anthropic ships Computer Use and a new Browser Use tool to general availability and launches a free Claude Academy, while OpenAI opens a new AI Futures policy research arm. Plus a deep dive on Jenni AI, the academic-writing assistant that grew from two thousand dollars a month to over ten million dollars a year in revenue, and why the Fundraising Regulator, grassroots sports tech and EV destination charging trackers are all quiet this week for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
